lines.zh: 嗡嗡飞行，似鬼魅般悄无声息。
lines.en: Buzzing by, silent as a ghost.
Skimming low, leaving chill in the air.

lines.zh: 翅膀轻拍，如同夜的低语。
lines.en: Wings flap, like night whispers.
Black wings, gliding through moonlight.

lines.zh: 飞行轨迹，如同幽灵游荡。
lines.en: Flight path, like a ghost wandering.
Following you until the dead of night.

lines.zh: 夜幕中，飘忽不定的身影。
lines.en: In the night, a flickering form.
Darkness and silence, your nightmare.
Wings beating, cold wind rises.
Silent, yet omnipresent.

lines.zh: 悬浮在你视线高度，寸步不离。
lines.en: I hover at eye level and never leave your side.

lines.zh: 十点血的身子，也敢追你十六格。
lines.en: Ten health, yet I chase you sixteen blocks.
Wings folded, waiting.
Drifting, observing.
Sneakily landing, resting.

lines.zh: 我停在半空数你的脚步。
lines.en: I hang still and count your steps.
Wings twitch, moving silently.
circling, unwavering.
Sailing, like a ghost.
Silently waiting, like the night.
Wings flutter, waiting.
Drifting, motionless.

lines.zh: 停在半空，像一盏不灭的灯。
lines.en: I hang in midair like a lamp that never goes out.

lines.zh: 细小躯壳悬着，等你转身。
lines.en: My tiny body floats, waiting for you to turn.

lines.zh: 薄翼收在身侧，数着你的呼吸。
lines.en: Wings folded, I count your breaths.

lines.zh: 停在你身后的暗处，一动不动。
lines.en: I rest in the dark behind you without moving.
Spotting you, eyes like fire.
Fixing on you, never letting go.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛随你的火把转。
lines.en: My eyes turn with your torch.
Following you, never looking away.
Fixing on you, chill rising.
I hover behind your shoulder, silent.
Sharp eyes, locking on target.
Following you, chilling.
Eyes like fire, never missing.
Fixing on you, breathless.
You turn around, and I am already watching.
My eyes follow every move you make.

lines.zh: 你走到哪，我的视线跟到哪。
lines.en: Wherever you walk, my gaze follows.

lines.zh: 目光落在你背后，凉飕飕的。
lines.en: My stare rests on your back, cold and steady.

lines.zh: 我不眨眼，就这么看着你。
lines.en: I do not blink. I just watch.

lines.zh: 你抬手，我的目光也跟着抬。
lines.en: You raise a hand, and my eyes rise with it.

lines.zh: 从阴影里探出眼睛，认准你。
lines.en: My eyes peek from the shadow and fix on you.

lines.zh: 十六格内，你跑不出我眼里。
lines.en: Within sixteen blocks you cannot leave my sight.

lines.zh: 看清你的脸，就不会认错了。
lines.en: Now I know your face and will not mistake it.

lines.zh: 你每一次呼吸，我都看在眼里。
lines.en: I see every breath you take.
The membrane is torn; I drop half a block.
Bone hurts!
I cannot fly now, only flutter.
Wing tired!
Can't fly!

lines.zh: 翅膜漏风，我歪着往下掉。
lines.en: My wing membrane leaks air; I tilt and drop.
Wing on fire!
No target!
Only ten health; one hit nearly ends me.
A wing shudders and I veer off course.

lines.zh: 你一靠近我就飞走了，真是个狡猾的小家伙。
lines.en: You get closer and I fly away, a crafty little one.

lines.zh: 我跟着你，只为多获取点食物。
lines.en: Following you just for more food.

lines.zh: 我的小翅膀能带我到你身边。
lines.en: My tiny wings can bring me near you.

lines.zh: 我得找个机会靠近你，然后偷取食物。
lines.en: I need to get close to steal some food.

lines.zh: 你身上的食物味道不错。
lines.en: The food on you smells good.

lines.zh: 我可不像你，整天吃吃吃。
lines.en: Unlike you, I don't eat all day.

lines.zh: 我需要更多的食物来保持飞行。
lines.en: More food to keep flying.

lines.zh: 你身上的食物吸引着我。
lines.en: The food on you attracts me.

lines.zh: 我跟着你，只为寻找更好的食物。
lines.en: Following you for better food.

lines.zh: 你身上的味道让我觉得安全。
lines.en: Your scent makes me feel safe.

lines.zh: 你的碰撞让我感到疼痛。
lines.en: Your collision hurts.
You hit me, be careful.

lines.zh: 我被你撞了，现在生气了。
lines.en: Hit by you, now angry.
Hit, fly higher now.

lines.zh: 你撞上我，我不会放过你。
lines.en: You hit me, I won't let you go.
You hit, I dodged.
You hit, I fly away.
You hit, I'm angry.

lines.zh: 我被你撞了，但我还是飞过去。
lines.en: Hit, I still fly over.
You hit, I dodged.

lines.zh: 飞了这么久，也想有个伴。
lines.en: After all this flying, I'd like company.
Find a better one.
I want to mate with you.
A night of flying; let us be mates.
Let's mate.
I need to join with you.
I need your love.

lines.zh: 我要与你分享我的爱情。
lines.en: Share my love with you.

lines.zh: 我只选你作为我的伴侣。
lines.en: You are my only choice.

lines.zh: 循着同类的翅声，飞去相会。
lines.en: I follow another's wingbeat to meet my kind.
Buzz, found food!
Lots of bugs here!
My stomach is louder than my wings.

lines.zh: 这一点血肉，够我飞一趟。
lines.en: This bit of flesh is worth a flight.

lines.zh: 我这小身板，只够飞行十六格。
lines.en: This little body only follows sixteen blocks.
This carcass is mine. Move along.
One wing flick and my target changes.
Bugs, bugs, my favorite!
Most bugs here.
The bugs in this alley are mine.

lines.zh: 我看见它躲到石头后了。
lines.en: I saw it duck behind the stone.
It moves; my wingtips tremble.
Food in sight.
Target locked.
It’s avoiding me.

lines.zh: 那个小东西，我要咬住它。
lines.en: That little thing — I'll bite it.
Food is moving.
I sense its presence.
Hold that dark shape down for me.

lines.zh: 我贴着地面朝它滑过去。
lines.en: I skim the ground toward it.
My wingbeat shifts, and I dive at you.

lines.zh: 我看见你手里那点火光了。
lines.en: I see that small flame in your hand.
You are alone. Perfect.
Your scent is locked; my wingtips tighten.

lines.zh: 从上方绕过去，堵你的路。
lines.en: I swing overhead to cut off your path.

lines.zh: 枯枝的响声，替你报了位置。
lines.en: The crack of dead wood gives your position away.
Targeting, ready to attack.
I’m going to eat it.
I must destroy it.
It’s in my sight.
I’ll attack it.
Ten points of health, and I still follow.
I’ll bite it.

lines.zh: 你藏哪，我的翅声就跟到哪。
lines.en: Wherever you hide, my wingbeat follows.
It breathes hard; I slip to its flank.
I circle above your head, waiting for you to look up.
I hug the wall so you cannot aim.
Raise your shield; I come from the side.

lines.zh: 低一点，再低一点，就够到了。
lines.en: Lower, just a little lower, and I can reach.

lines.zh: 翅尖划着圈，找你的空当。
lines.en: My wingtips trace circles, hunting a gap.

lines.zh: 你喘气的节奏，我记住了。
lines.en: I have memorized the rhythm of your breathing.
One more foot and my teeth reach you.
You step back, and I press closer.
I hang still, waiting for that one instant.
I circle right above your shadow.

lines.zh: 我数着翅拍，第三次就扑。
lines.en: I count my wingbeats; the third is the dive.
Sssss, you've crossed the line!

lines.zh: 你动我一动，我咬你一口！
lines.en: You touch me, I bite you!
Stay back, I'm going to eat you!
Come on, try to bite me!
My venom will make you regret!
Do not laugh. Ten health is still health.
My claws catch your sleeve.
I am small, but my teeth are not.

lines.zh: 你动我一动，我就动你一动！
lines.en: Touch me and I'll touch you!
My poison will kill you!
I bite your shoulder. Does it hurt?
My teeth are small but they hold tight.
I drop down onto the back of your neck.
The wind of my wings slaps your face.
I bite and withdraw; you cannot hit me.

lines.zh: 十点血，我也要咬你一口。
lines.en: Ten health or not, I still bite.
Here they come!
Danger lurks in the darkness!
They hide in the shadows!
Find their nest!
Be careful, they appear suddenly!
They are night's guardians!
They're in the sky!
Find them and destroy them!
The night is their stage!

lines.zh: 它们从不眠的天空降下！
lines.en: They descend from the never-sleeping sky!

lines.zh: 猎杀阶段到了，我该出场。
lines.en: The hunt stage is here. Time for me to appear.

lines.zh: 故事翻到这一页，我来了。
lines.en: The story reached this page, so I arrived.

lines.zh: 从结局线的暗处飞出来。
lines.en: I fly out from the dark between the endings.

lines.zh: 有人放下刷怪蛋，我就出来了。
lines.en: Someone placed a spawn egg, and out I came.

lines.zh: 夜色一沉，我从缝里钻出。
lines.en: As night thickens I squeeze out of a crack.
You open the door, and I am already inside.

lines.zh: 三点伤害的小东西，来了。
lines.en: The little thing with three damage is here.
The dark has gained another pair of wings.
I was waiting before the story began.
The moment you light the lamp, I appear.
My wings are limp as rags.

lines.zh: 骨头疼，摔落的滋味可不好受。
lines.en: Bone hurts! — and the fall makes it worse.

lines.zh: 翅膀折了，溺水的滋味可不好受。
lines.en: Wing broken! — and the drown makes it worse.

lines.zh: 翅膀累了，遭爆炸的滋味可不好受。
lines.en: Wing tired! — and the explosion makes it worse.

lines.zh: 飞不动了，中箭的滋味可不好受。
lines.en: Can't fly! — and the projectile makes it worse.

lines.zh: 翅膀被砍了，中魔法的滋味可不好受。
lines.en: Wing cut! — and the magic makes it worse.

lines.zh: 翅膀着火了，挨饿的滋味可不好受。
lines.en: Wing on fire! — and the starvation makes it worse.

lines.zh: 找不到目标，遭雷击的滋味可不好受。
lines.en: No target! — and the lightning makes it worse.

lines.zh: 才十点血，一碰就见底，坠入虚空的滋味可不好受。
lines.en: Only ten health; one hit nearly ends me — and the void makes it worse.
